caseName: Houston Fire & Casualty Insurance v. United States
caseNameFull: Houston Fire & Casualty Insurance Co. v. United States
attorneys: Reagan Sayers for appellant. Acting Solicitor General Stern and E. M. Reidy for the United States and the Interstate Commerce Commission, appellees.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the United States District Court for the Northern District of Texas.

Per Curiam:

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed.

Mr. Justice Black is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted and the case set down for oral argument.
